rules.replacement: LogInfoEvent(BCLog::ALL, "script_execution_cache_initialized", "Using {cache_allocated_mib} MiB out of {cache_requested_mib} MiB requested for script execution cache, able to store {cache_capacity} elements").Field(BCLog::LogField::CacheAllocatedMiB, approx_size_bytes >> 20).Field(BCLog::LogField::CacheRequestedMiB, script_execution_cache_bytes >> 20).Field(BCLog::LogField::CacheCapacity, num_elems)

rules.review_note: Preserve Info, readable text, original integer MiB shifts/capacity values, signed int64 pressure arithmetic, real double MiB resizing and exact .1f consumer formatting. X(TxHash, tx_hash, HASH, "", "") \
    X(CacheAllocatedMiB, cache_allocated_mib, UINT, "", "") \
    X(CacheRequestedMiB, cache_requested_mib, UINT, "", "") \
    X(CacheCapacity, cache_capacity, UINT, "", "") \
    X(CacheSizeBytes, cache_size_bytes, INT, "", "") \
    X(CacheBudgetBytes, cache_budget_bytes, INT, "", "") \
    X(CoinsTipCacheBudgetMiB, coins_tip_cache_budget_mib, FLOAT, "", "")
